content: Is it possible to share Awakeners' sprite animations? With the sprites being small, it can be hard to appreciate all the details put in to their animations; I especially like seeing the different Rouse effects for each Awakener (Nymphaea breaking out of a coffin is one of my favorites), so I would love it if there was a gallery to view all of them.
